시편 24:1.content: A Psalm of David. The earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

시편 24:2.content: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

시편 24:3.content: Who shall ascend into the hill of the Lord? or who shall stand in his holy place?

시편 24:4.content: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.

시편 24:5.content: He shall receive the blessing from the Lord, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

시편 24:6.content: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.

시편 24:7.content: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

시편 24:8.content: Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle.

시편 24:9.content: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

시편 24:10.content: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.
